proposed_result: Exact dependency finding: the target is a valid checked reduction C → O, not a proof of O. It uses C only at odd k > 2, after an elementary proof that k + 1 is composite. Thus the smallest exposed missing mathematical dependency is the odd-input restriction of the composite lower bound: for every odd k > 2, k + 1 < χ(J(2k,k)). No current-tree declaration supplies that unbounded restriction without a sorry; the ≤300 route also inherits a separate sorry. Therefore the current bytes cannot truthfully be improved to an unconditional odd-case proof.
